passages.title: Số điện thoại khẩn cấp
passages.bodyText: Emergency numbers in Vietnam. Police: 113. Fire: 114. Ambulance: 115. When you call, speak slowly and clearly. Say what happened, where you are and how many people are hurt. Don't put the phone down before the operator tells you. Save these numbers in your phone today.

lessons.title: Week 4 review
lessons.description: Ôn tập tuần 4: past simple, will / be going to, gọi điện, hẹn gặp, thời tiết và sự cố.

activities.title: Kiểm tra cuối tuần 4
activities.instructionsVi: 15 câu ngẫu nhiên từ các bài trong tuần, rồi một cuộc hội thoại với AI (không có gợi ý). Cần 70 điểm và hoàn thành nhiệm vụ nói để hoàn thành chặng A1.

payload.sentence: Yesterday I ___ (work) until eight.
We ___ (go) to Hue last summer.
___ you call your mother last night?
The meeting ___ (not / start) on time.

exercises.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
exercises.explanationVi: Có dấu hiệu sắp xảy ra → is going to.

payload.sentence: I'm tired. I think I ___ go to bed early.

exercises.explanationVi: I think I'll… = quyết định ngay.

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại
exercises.explanationVi: didn't + động từ nguyên mẫu: come.

payload.sentence: He visited his parents.

accepted: He did not visit his parents.
What are you going to do tomorrow?

exercises.explanationVi: What + are + you + going to + do?

payload.sentence: Don't worry. I ___ (tell) him.
I'm busy now. I ___ call you back later.

exercises.prompt: The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.
exercises.explanationVi: Quyết định ngay lúc nói → I'll.

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại
exercises.explanationVi: Sau will dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: call.

payload.sourceVi: Tôi sẽ gọi lại cho bạn.

exercises.prompt: Số điện thoại của Tom là gì?

accepted: Good morning, ABC Company. Lan speaking.
Hello. Can I speak to Mr Nam, please?

payload.sentence: We ___ (have) a party on Saturday. (kế hoạch)
___ you going to come to my birthday?

exercises.prompt: She ___ going to invite all her colleagues.

accepted: What are you going to do this weekend?

exercises.explanationVi: Từ để hỏi + are + you + going to + động từ?

payload.sourceVi: Tối nay tôi định đi xem hòa nhạc.

reference: I'm going to go to a concert tonight.
I am going to go to a concert tonight.
I'm going to a concert tonight.
Tonight I'm going to go to a concert.

exercises.explanationVi: Kế hoạch → I'm going to + go…

exercises.prompt: Tiệc bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?

accepted: Hi Linh! Are you free on Saturday evening?

exercises.prompt: A: 'We have no milk.' B: 'OK, I ___ buy some.' (quyết định ngay)
exercises.explanationVi: Quyết định ngay lúc nói → will.

exercises.prompt: I ___ visit my parents next weekend. I booked the tickets.
exercises.explanationVi: Kế hoạch có sẵn → going to.

payload.sentence: Let's ___ (meet) at the cafe.
Where ___ we meet? — At the station.

exercises.explanationVi: Hỏi tương lai: Where will / shall we…?

payload.sourceVi: Chúng ta gặp nhau lúc bảy giờ nhé.

exercises.prompt: Họ gặp nhau lúc mấy giờ?

accepted: Yes! Let's go together. What about Saturday?

payload.sentence: Sorry, I ___ come on Friday. I'm sick. (không thể)
Don't worry. I ___ be late. (sẽ không)
We ___ (not / go) to the beach. It's raining. (không định)

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại
exercises.explanationVi: going to + động từ nguyên mẫu: come.

payload.sentence: We are going to meet on Monday.

accepted: We aren't going to meet on Monday.
We are not going to meet on Monday.
We're not going to meet on Monday.
My manager wants me to work on Saturday.

payload.sentence: Yesterday it ___ (be) very hot.
We ___ (be) at the beach last weekend.

exercises.prompt: Tomorrow it ___ rain in the afternoon.
Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại

exercises.explanationVi: Quá khứ của it is → it was.

accepted: Yes, it's warm and sunny. Yesterday was so cold!

payload.sentence: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my grandmother.
We ___ (go) to the beach on Sunday.
She ___ (have) dinner with her friends.

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại

accepted: Hi Nam! Did you have a good weekend?

payload.sentence: ___ you send the parcel yesterday?

exercises.prompt: Did she receive the letter? — Yes, she ___.
exercises.explanationVi: Hỏi Did → trả lời did / didn't.

payload.sentence: When did you ___ (send) it?

exercises.explanationVi: Sau did dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại
exercises.explanationVi: Did + động từ nguyên mẫu: send.

accepted: Where did you buy the stamps?

exercises.explanationVi: Từ để hỏi + did + chủ ngữ + động từ?

exercises.prompt: Bưu kiện nặng bao nhiêu ki-lô?
Phí gửi bao nhiêu nghìn đồng?

accepted: Next, please. How can I help?

payload.sentence: The printer ___ (not / work) this morning.
I ___ (not / break) it. It was old.
The water ___ (not / be) hot yesterday.

exercises.explanationVi: be quá khứ phủ định: wasn't.

exercises.prompt: Chạm vào từ sai và sửa lại
exercises.explanationVi: didn't + động từ nguyên mẫu: work.

payload.sentence: The light turned on.

accepted: The light did not turn on.

I'm sorry. When did it stop?

Don't worry. I ___ call the police.

payload.sentence: What ___ (happen)? — There was an accident.
Where ___ you? — I was at home.
